prose: Meta's ExecuTorch WebGPU backend runs PyTorch models on the GPU inside WebGPU browsers, without converting to GGUF, ONNX or TFLite. Browser inference keeps prompts and outputs on-device, cuts latency, works offline and lowers server cost; WebGPU's compute shaders and shared memory make it viable. Works across desktop, laptop and mobile browsers.
highlights: PyTorch models run in-browser on WebGPU, no format conversion
On-device: privacy, offline, lower server cost
Chrome, Firefox and Safari, desktop and mobile
